# CanvasGroups and HiddenTick bypass the Neo class system

## Context

@tobiu, after merging #19125 without a round, since the PR was large: *"anti-pattern, the class should extend core.Base and use configs. not extendable and neo overwrites won't work otherwise. the same for src/worker/HiddenTick.mjs … it does not even use Neo.gatekeep."*

Both classes are mine: `Neo.worker.CanvasGroups` from #19125 and `Neo.worker.HiddenTick` from #18755.

## The Problem

Both are plain JavaScript classes. Their JSDoc claims `@class Neo.worker.*`, but neither class exists in the Neo namespace:

| | `CanvasGroups` (`src/worker/CanvasGroups.mjs`) | `HiddenTick` (`src/worker/HiddenTick.mjs`) |
|---|---|---|
| Declared | `class CanvasGroups {}`, `export default CanvasGroups` | `class HiddenTick {}`, `export default HiddenTick` |
| Tunable | `startBound` (30 s), a constructor option | `interval` (1 s), a constructor argument |
| Collaborator | `isDeparted`, a constructor option | `worker`, a constructor argument |
| Registered | no `Neo.setupClass`, no `Neo.gatekeep` | neither |
| Teardown | none: per-group `setTimeout` bounds and open channels outlive their owner | none: per-window timers outlive their owner |

So `Neo.overwrites` cannot change either tunable. A subclass cannot use the config system, and nothing reaches the classes by namespace.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Neo.setupClass` (`src/Neo.mjs`) merges static configs down the chain, applies `Neo.overwrites` through `applyOverwrites`, generates reactive accessors, and registers the class first-one-wins.
- `core.Base`'s `static config` contract (`src/core/Base.mjs`): non-reactive configs live on the prototype and are the `Neo.overwrites` surface. Class fields hold internal state and never share a name with a config (`assertFieldsShadowNoConfig`). `construct` and `destroy` are the lifecycle.
- `Neo.gatekeep` is the lightweight registration for classes that cannot extend `core.Base`. Neither class needs that exception.
- Consumers:
  - `App.mjs` creates both as class fields with `new`.
  - `Manager.mjs` and `Canvas.mjs` call `CanvasGroups`' statics (`resolveCarrier`, `mint`, `groupFromWorkerName`) and its two exported constants, without an instance.
  - Specs: `CanvasGroups`, `CanvasGroupLifetimes`, `CanvasBootstrap` and `HiddenTick`.

## The Fix

1. Both extend `core.Base` with `static config = {className: 'Neo.worker.CanvasGroups' | 'Neo.worker.HiddenTick', …}` and end in `export default Neo.setupClass(…)`.
2. Tunables and collaborators become non-reactive configs: `startBound`, `isDeparted`, `interval`, `worker`. Internal state stays in class fields (`groups`, `pending`, `retired`, `windows`; `timers`), with no name shared with a config.
3. `destroy()` clears the timers. `CanvasGroups` also retires its open channels.
4. The App creates both with `Neo.create` in `construct()`, not as `new` class fields.
5. The statics and exported constants stay on the class. The main thread uses them without an instance.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Both classes extend `core.Base`, are finalized by `Neo.setupClass`, and resolve at `Neo.worker.CanvasGroups` and `Neo.worker.HiddenTick`.
- [ ] A `Neo.overwrites` entry changes each tunable's default (`startBound`, `interval`), with one unit arm per class.
- [ ] `destroy()` leaves no pending timer, and no open channel for `CanvasGroups`, with a unit arm per class.
- [ ] The App creates both through `Neo.create`, and the existing behavior specs pass unchanged in what they assert, plus the canvas e2e specs.

## Out of Scope

The same census over `src/` found four more plain classes, each needing its own disposition:
- `Neo.worker.Message` and `Neo.core.Util` register by hand through `Neo.ns`. `Util` cannot extend `Base`, because `Base` imports it.
- `Neo.main.draggable.Resize` and `Neo.functional.util.HtmlTemplate` are unregistered.
